column1: # analysis/naming2/wramx_calls.tsv -- the effect of a routine on the WRAM bank in force, for the backward scan of tools/apply_ram_operands.py (docs/research/naming2_ramop7.md)
# effect: `keeps` = the bank in force after the call is the one before it (the routine writes no bank register, or saves the shadow at entry and restores it at exit);
#         `sets W7` = it is bank 7 after the call (the routine selects it and does not restore).
# A routine that is not listed is unknown: a call to it between a bank switch and a site ends the proof.  Every row says how the effect was read.
